notes.key_messages: (cid:127) When describing graphical results, numerical values extracted should be accompanied by both the x-axis and y-axis descriptions, with units given. (cid:127) A description of a mode of transmission for a named disease must show understanding that the pathogen is passed from an infected person to an uninfected person. (cid:127) The shape of the active site of an enzyme, when compared to its specific substrate shape, should be described as complementary, and not as similar, same or matching.
